power: Change wake up timers create semantics This change changes the semantics of creating wake up timers via powerd. Before this change, the D-Bus API for creating wake up timers would return an error if the string tag passed as an argument already has timers registered. With this change, the create API implicitly deletes any old timers registered with the same tag. This change is introduced to lessen the IPC calls made by a client while creating and starting timers and also easily support the case of Chrome and ARC container dying while powerd remains alive. BUG=chromium:916044 TEST=Modify and run unit tests. Change-Id: I3c866f2e058175121154b1014a6d45ec74c4c6ef Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1493816 Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Tested-by: Abhishek Bhardwaj <abhishekbh@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org>

FROMLIST: ASoC: AMD: Configure master codec on all playback/capture cases In the system design da7219 is the master codec and clocks are generated by it. Bclk is to be generated at the required rate for other codecs used when da7219 is acting only as clock master. For this call hw_params of da7219 during playback/capture on non da7219 codecs. Being able to set bclk at lower rate also fixes noise issue observed on some dmics.
